name: speaking-ai-professor-mobile
description: Cloud-only Android APK for Speaking AI Professor (PDF.js + 12-template animated chalkboard + Gemini Cloud + Native Android TTS, zero local models).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
